name: Triple F Distributing, a Division of Imperial Dade.
old_description: Since 1935, Imperial Dade has delivered critical supplies to our customers. Throughout our history, our customer's success is our highest priority. We create custom solutions that accelerate their business forward.
about:
Triple F Distributing operates as a division of Imperial Dade, which merged with BradyPLUS in 2024 to form Imperial Brady. The business traces its roots to 1935 when Imperial Dade began delivering critical supplies from its headquarters in Kailua-Kona, Hawaii. The company remains rooted in a family-owned legacy built over generations.

Imperial Brady functions as a North American distributor of foodservice packaging, commercial cleaning supplies, janitorial equipment, and industrial packaging. The network spans more than 230 locations with over 13,000 associates and 2,400 account representatives. The company sources from more than 1,000 manufacturers, including 3M, Rubbermaid, Tennant, Spartan Chemical, and P&G Pro, and offers equipment sales and service alongside sustainable product options certified by third parties such as BPI, Green Seal, and FSC.

The distributor serves foodservice, healthcare, hospitality, education, grocery, retail, industrial, redistribution, commercial real estate, federal government, and municipal operations. Customers range from independent restaurants and schools to venues such as Ball Arena and federal agencies.

Leadership states the purpose is to help customers thrive by delivering supplies and support with speed, reliability, and expertise, a model shaped by the family-business heritage that prioritizes trust and long-term partnerships.
